title: Web Scrape Book Data
description:
Write a Python script to scrape data from http://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/page-1.html.
Your program must:
1. Extract the title, price, and availability of each book listed on the page.
2. Store the data in a CSV file named books_output.csv.
3. Use requests and BeautifulSoup libraries only.
4. Ensure your script handles at least 20 books.
